title: Advanced Paste can leave Shift stuck with Caps Lock → Ctrl remap
author: jincechen

status.label: Duplicate modifier-release bug
status.detail: Maintainers have consolidated Advanced Paste modifier keys remaining logically pressed under open issue #27612.

judgment.rationale: The symptom and recovery match the open modifier-release tracker #42471; the automated duplicate digest also identifies #42471 as the canonical issue for this report, while #27612 was itself closed as a duplicate of #25678.
evidence: Shift remains logically pressed after Advanced Paste and is released by pressing the modifier combination again.
The problem disappears when Advanced Paste is disabled while the Caps Lock → Ctrl remap remains enabled.
The current duplicate digest names #42471 as the canonical tracker for this report, alongside the closely related #46874.
judgment.recommended_action: Post a duplicate response linking the open #42471 tracker and retain the Caps Lock → Ctrl interaction as additional reproduction evidence there.

issue_context.summary: Using Advanced Paste through a Caps Lock → Ctrl remap can intermittently leave Shift logically held, affecting taskbar clicks and text selection until the modifier combination is pressed again.
known_information: The physical sequence is Caps Lock + Shift + V, transformed into Ctrl + Shift + V by Keyboard Manager.
Disabling Advanced Paste while keeping the remap removes the symptom.
The current duplicate digest identifies open #42471 as the canonical issue for this report and also records related #46874 evidence.
inferences: The remapped modifier path may expose the same release/restore weakness through a different physical-key state, but it does not yet establish a distinct root cause.
issue_context.analysis: The report is specific and useful, but current duplicate evidence routes it to open #42471. Consolidation preserves the new remap evidence without starting a parallel fix investigation; the previously cited #27612 is not an appropriate active tracker because it was closed as a duplicate.

Inspected AdvancedPasteModuleInterface/dllmain.cpp, where held modifiers are released before injected copy/paste and then restored with SendInput, matching the affected behavior boundary.

comment.body: Thanks for the detailed Caps Lock → Ctrl reproduction and for confirming that disabling Advanced Paste removes the problem. The current duplicate review identifies open #42471 as the canonical tracker for Advanced Paste cases where modifiers remain logically pressed; #46874 is recorded as closely related evidence. This issue should be closed as a duplicate of #42471, with the Keyboard Manager remap sequence retained there as useful additional reproduction evidence. The previously cited #27612 is itself closed as a duplicate, so it is not the active tracker.
